UI_trait_KFM_respiratoryDesc: A history of breathing trouble. Exertion costs more endurance while the condition is active. Rest, paced recovery and the appropriate breathing aid help recovery.
UI_trait_KFM_cardiacDesc: A history of heart and breathing strain. Heavy exertion adds fatigue and severe exhaustion can cause a brief faint. Rest and appropriate care help recovery.
UI_trait_KFM_stresssensitivityDesc: Stress leaves you on edge. Slightly better focus during examinations, but faster fatigue and occasional unsettling perceptions until recovery.
UI_trait_KFM_resilienceDesc: Practiced recovery habits. A temporary benefit to medical task speed and endurance recovery while resting.
